description: The Sturm pivot tau_j equals the j-th subdiscriminant of P. H_j is a positive normalization of tau_j. The subdiscriminant is a Vandermonde-square sum and hence non-negative.
vandermonde_expansion: tau_j = sum_{|I|=j+1} prod_{i<k in I} (x_k - x_i)^2

proof_steps.1_subdiscriminant: The j-th subdiscriminant of P is defined as the sum over all (j+1)-element index sets I of the squared Vandermonde product over I.
proof_steps.2_cauchy_binet: By the Cauchy-Binet identity, the subdiscriminant determinant factors as a sum of squares of minors, establishing tau_j >= 0.
proof_steps.3_normalization: The Sturm pivot H_j is defined as N_j * tau_j where N_j > 0 is the explicit positive normalization constant from the subresultant PRS normalization.
proof_steps.4_chain: Jensen hyperbolicity => all roots real => all tau_j > 0 => Sturm sequence is valid => positivity propagates.

claim: tau_j = Disc_j(P) is established via Cauchy-Binet/Vandermonde. H_j = N_j tau_j with N_j > 0 is established via subresultant normalization.
